label: Integral sheaves: nonnegativity of weights and the lower bounds of Corollary 3.3.3
excerpt: Call a sheaf integral if the eigenvalues of all Frobenii are algebraic integers. The weights of a mixed integral sheaf are ≥ 0: if an algebraic integer α is pure of weight n relative to q and of degree d, its norm is an ordinary integer of absolute value q^{nd/2}, so n ≥ 0. Writing Z = P/Q with P, Q ∈ Z[t] coprime and positive constant terms, Fatou's lemma (Z ∈ Z[[t]] with constant term 1) forces the constant terms of P and Q to be 1.
